subject: general
question: Exercise LA PEROUSE recently seen in news is related to:

options.text: A joint military exercise focused on land-based warfare.
A multinational naval exercise aimed at enhancing maritime cooperation and interoperability.
A humanitarian assistance mission conducted by the United Nations.
A space exploration project led by the European Space Agency.

solution: The correct answer is __**option 2**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** • The fourth edition of Exercise LA PEROUSE, a multinational naval exercise, is being conducted to strengthen maritime collaboration and promote a rules-based order in the Indo-Pacific region.
